Man's Best Friend | Stand Up Comedy By Rakesh Addlakha
My 2nd Standup comedy video. This video is dedicated to my dog "Sweety". In this video, I'm sharing extracts from being a dog parent/hooman.
I hope she is getting enough warmth in heaven. We miss you "Sweety".
Watch this video and share your experience with your pets in the comments section. Family me sabko video dikhao aur share karo.
